ABSENCE_IS_NOT_ZERO: the resizer ran but printed no `Found N capacitance violations` line. OpenROAD emits that line only when N > 0 (measured: 703 such lines over 103 real logs, none with N=0), so this artefact cannot distinguish 'zero capacitance violations' from 'repair_design was never called'

NO_SUCH_FIGURE: OpenROAD's resizer states DRV counts only BEFORE repair_design repairs them and no build on record re-prints a residual. The post-repair residual is an OpenSTA `report_check_types -max_slew -max_capacitance -max_fanout` question and belongs to the opensta backend
